rivals.name: Kenn
rivals.title: Blade of Celestia
rivals.description_markdown: Kenn is a mobile assassin built around rapid pressure and buff windows. Kenn excels at short kill windows, chaining healing, fast movement and swift damage.

abilities.name: Bladeshot
abilities.description_markdown: Throw one blade toward aim. This attack deals **80** base damage. If [Spectre](ability://ultimate) is active,blade type changes and heals Kenn for **20%** dealt damage. If [Assassin's thrust](ability://signature_ii) is active, each blade also applies **Bleed**.

abilities.name: Bladespread
abilities.description_markdown:
Kenn throws a 5-blade fan with random spread. Every
blade inherits all [Bladeshot](ability://basic) modifiers (Spectre heal, Swiftness bleed).

abilities.name: Furry of blades
abilities.description_markdown: Kenn spawns a tornado and enters a defensive state. Gaining **Protection** for **2.0s** and emitting rotating blade pairs towards aim.

abilities.name: Assassin's thrust
abilities.description_markdown: Kenn gains a long mobility boost, gaining the **Swiftness** effect for **12s**. While active, [Bladeshot](ability://basic) and [Bladespread](ability://alternate) blades apply **Bleed**.

abilities.name: Spectre
abilities.description_markdown:
Kenn transforms into **Spectre** form. During Spectre, blade hits heal Kenn for **20%** of damage. On kill during Spectre, Kenn
gains the **Invisibility** effect for **2s**.

rivals.name: Gramin
rivals.title: Commander of Celestia
rivals.description_markdown: Gramin is a marksman that controls space with bullets, grenades, and heavy artillery. He can sustain himself during battles and can be relied on to hold off enemies.

abilities.name: Rifle / Dawnbreaker
abilities.description_markdown: Gramin shoots a single bullet using his currently equipped weapon.

abilities.name: Burst sequence
abilities.description_markdown: Gramin rapidly fires multiple bullets using his currently equipped weapon.

abilities.name: Grenade / Detonate
abilities.description_markdown: Gramin throws a grenade that explodes after 5.0s, **RECAST** to detonate it early.

abilities.name: Combat medkit
abilities.description_markdown: Gramins heals himself for 40 HP.

abilities.name: Same plan, different weapon
abilities.description_markdown:
Gramin charges his Dawnbreaker and gears up with it. Once active, Dawnbreaker stance lasts **40.0s**. During that
state, a **RECAST** launches a powerful rocket that propels Gramin backward. On impact, the rocket explodes and
then splits into 4 explosive debris projectiles. Gramin can also shoot more powerful bullets using [Rifle / Dawnbreaker](ability://basic) and [Burst sequence](ability://alternate).

rivals.name: Lenya
rivals.title: Blessed Crystalweaver
rivals.description_markdown:
Lenya blends ranged poke, selective healing, and utility setups. She is a flexible front-to-back rival with
two shot profiles and strong combo utility.

abilities.name: Fireshot
abilities.description_markdown: Lenya shoots her fireball, dealing **60** damage. It also applies a small heal.

abilities.name: Manashot
abilities.description_markdown: Lenya shoots her manaball. This variant deals **10** damage. In exchange, it provides **30** healing.

abilities.name: Vitality capsule
abilities.description_markdown: Lenya deploys a bouncing orb. The orb bounces up to **3** times before exploding, dealing damage to enemies and healing allies. **RECAST** to detonate the orb early.

abilities.name: Arc barrier
abilities.description_markdown: Lenya creates and shapes a wall barrier from her current aim direction. **HOLD** to bend the wall while it's created.

abilities.name: Blessful aura
abilities.description_markdown: Lenya channels her two elemental energies into her amulet, and detonates the energy into a large aura field around her, any enemies caught in the field get damaged and continue to bleed as long as they are in the field, and any allies in the field heal and continue to heal as long as they are in the field.

rivals.name: Masr
rivals.title: Stormblade
rivals.description_markdown: Masr is a speed-focused disruptor. Masr excels at focused burst damage and fast retreats, making a lack of coordination his only potential weakness.

abilities.name: Thunderbolt
abilities.description_markdown: Masr throws a lightning bolt projectile. If [Stormwrath](ability://ultimate) is active, the lightning bolt gains bounce.

abilities.name: Charged thunderbolt
abilities.description_markdown: Masr charges his sword and queues a heavier bolt release. On collision, the charged bolt triggers an explosion.

abilities.name: Storm barrier
abilities.description_markdown: Masr perform a slash that places an oriented light wall that blocks only projectiles.

abilities.name: Tempest blink
abilities.description_markdown: **PASSIVE**: Masr can dash in any direction and has a higher dash range. When [Stormwrath](ability://ultimate) is active, his dashes grant him Invisibility.

abilities.name: Stormwrath
abilities.description_markdown: Masr channels Stormwrath and enters empowered state. While active, his [Thunderbolts](ability://basic) gain stronger bounce/explosion interactions.
